verdict.rationale: A partner or third-party agent-app ecosystem is a fair axis for a coding agent, but the evidence pack shows no marketplace, plugin system or partner-app integration. The nearby evidence covers other things: editor connectors (first-party IDE integrations), bring-your-own OpenAI-compatible models (models, not agent apps), /agents (which groups ByteAsk's own sessions) and a first-party MCP server. None of these show integrating partner-built agent apps.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
